announce.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.death: Even... a king... turns to dust...
announce.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.intro: Kneel. All things age before the king.
announce.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.phase2: The moon shall pass its verdict!
block.isekai_mahou.fey_ring_stone.hint: At night, offer Light Essence, Fairy Dust or a Moonpetal: the Ring leads to the Fey Realm.
block.isekai_mahou.garganta_altar.hint: At night, offer a Shadow Essence or a Mask Fragment: the sky tears open to the Hollow World.
boss.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.subtitle: Sovereign of the Palace of Eternal Night
boss.isekai_mahou.sand_empress.subtitle: Mistress of the Sand Garden
boss.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.subtitle: Morgwen, Sovereign of the Fey Court
cutscene.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.arrive: The dusk that never ends. Beware the giggles.
White sand, a moon that never sets... and something hungry watching.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fey_charm.desc: Effect (Light): bewitches the target — monsters forget you and attack the nearest monster; players get dizzy. Bosses are only slowed.
glyph.isekai_mahou.fey_thornbind.desc: Effect (Earth): a rosebush bursts under the target — damage, root and bleeding.
glyph.isekai_mahou.garganta_reishi.desc: Quincy origin effect: weaves a reishi bridge to the Hollow World where the spell lands (on Self, in front of you); inside it, opens the way back. 2 min cooldown.
glyph.isekai_mahou.garganta_senkai.desc: Shinigami origin effect: tears a gate to the Hollow World where the spell lands (on Self, in front of you); inside it, opens the way back. 2 min cooldown.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollow_cero.desc: Effect (Shadow): a focused beam from your hand to the target — heavy single-target damage, a small blast and knockback.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollow_gran_cero.desc: Legendary effect (Shadow, Circle 7): the King's Cero — a huge golden beam and a blast hitting everyone around (Expand widens it).
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollow_hierro.desc: Effect (Earth): the skin hardens — Resistance (II with Amplify) for 10 s, slightly slower.
glyph.isekai_mahou.hollow_sonido.desc: Effect (Wind): instant step — the target dashes up to 7 blocks forward (Amplify goes further), leaving afterimages. On Self: a dodge.
glyph.isekai_mahou.reishi_rend.desc: Quincy origin effect (Light): reishi that unmakes spirits — double damage to Hollows; each hit returns 2% of the resource to the Quincy.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sand_tide.desc: Effect (Earth): a wave of white sand hits the target — damage, knockback and brief blindness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.visored_mask.desc: Shinigami origin effect (Shadow): pulls on the inner Hollow's mask — Strength II, Speed and Resistance for 12 s; hunger afterwards.
item.isekai_mahou.arrancar_soul_shard.de: Shinigami and Quincy absorb it: XP and a full resource bar. Ingredient of the Garganta Key.
item.isekai_mahou.decay_axe.desc: From the Hollow King. Every hit ages the target: wither and slowness.
item.isekai_mahou.garganta_key.desc: Tears a Garganta in front of you: from the Overworld to the Hollow World, or back. Consumed on use.
item.isekai_mahou.queen_wings.desc: From the Thorn Queen. Spread them: 30 s of slow falling, jump and speed. Repair with Fairy Dust.
item.isekai_mahou.reishi_crystal.desc: Restores 30% of your class resource (Shinigami and Quincy: 50% and Strength).
item.isekai_mahou.tide_sand_blade.desc: From the Sand Empress. Right-click: a Blue-Sand Wave in a line (damage, knockback, blindness).
message.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.breath: Breath of Senescence: get out of the cone!
message.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.exhaust: The King is exhausted: strike now!
message.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.pools: Pools of Decay follow you — keep moving!
message.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.respira: Respira! Run to the green zones!
message.isekai_mahou.hollow_king.resurre: The King is bare bones now: he is faster!
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.fey_rea: The fairies only dance at night.
Offer Light Essence, Fairy Dust or a Moonpetal.
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.gate_al: There is already a gate open here.
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.hollow_: The Garganta only opens under the moon: come back at night.
Offer a Shadow Essence or a Hollow Mask Fragment.
The Garganta is open! Step into the rift.
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.not_in_: You are not in one of the realms.
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.reishi_: The reishi restores some of your power.
Reishi flows through you! (+50%% and Strength)
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.shortcu: The shortcut is still recovering: %s s.
You learned the Reishi Bridge: a glyph that tears a path to the Hollow World (Grimoire).
Your Zanpakuto learned to open the Senkai Gate: a glyph that tears a path to the Hollow World (Grimoire).
A Garganta can only be torn in the Overworld or inside the Hollow World.
message.isekai_mahou.hueco_mundo.soul_sh: Only Shinigami and Quincy can absorb souls. (It is still a crafting material.)
message.isekai_mahou.sand_empress.cross: Crossing tides: stand between the lines!
message.isekai_mahou.sand_empress.dive: She dove into the sand — run from the circle chasing you!
message.isekai_mahou.sand_empress.storm: Sandstorm: stay close to your allies!
message.isekai_mahou.sand_empress.whirl: Whirlpool: don't let it drag you to the center!
message.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.charm: Queen's Charm: move away from the marks!
message.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.court: The Mischievous Court defends its queen!
message.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.seeds: Seeds fall around you: don't stand still!
message.isekai_mahou.thorn_queen.verdict: Moon's Verdict: get into the green circles or turn to stone!
